description: In a right chain, r → x s r, a terminator elided at the start of the separator follows the item, whose node is its constituent. Here a could be longer, so maximal forbids the elided T, and the text is rejected (engine §3.3, §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy maximal
%elidable T
%rule text c
%rule c {a ... \ [T] s}
%rule a A | A B
%rule s B S
